Best way to connect PS4 controller to Galaxy S5?

Buy an OTG Cable. You should be able to find one for about $5. Please note that an OTG cable and a regular USB cable are different even though they appear the same. The OTG cable has one extra pin which tells your phone to enter USB host mode. If you just connect a regular USB cable it will not work.

OTG cables often also come as a Y-Split cable. The point of this is to allow you to supply additional power to devices for which your phone may not supply sufficient power to run, such as external hard drives.

For these first few, these icy blue.” I paused a moment to think. “Shardstones. These icy blue shardstones will have the ability to conjure up ice. However, they will only be able to conjure up ice when exposed to temperatures that would normally freeze water.” I held out my other hand. Within was another shardstone, but instead of an icy blue hue it was fiery red. “These red shardstones will provide protection to nearby life from the raging heat of Ithica. The smallest of them will be able to prevent minor burns and the largest of them may allow a group of creatures to swim safely through the fiery seas of Ithica. These stones will not be all powerful for they will quickly drain the magical energies stored within them. To counteract this, they may be recharged, within a limit, by having fresh water poured on them. In this way, the fresh water will be consumed by the stone and transformed into the magical energy the stone needs to be able to provide its protection.” With but a thought I conjured thousands of the stones of various shapes and sizes and flung them into Ithica’s seas. “These stones will have their power increase exponentially to their size and will become prized by those who find themselves on Ithica.”

A firey-red shardstone the size of a fist would be able to protect up to 3 nearby creatures from the full effects of swimming through lava for 10 minutes.
